answer: Every agent identity locks a refundable bond before it can attest. Attestation weight scales quadratically, so a puppet swarm pays N squared for the reach one honest voter gets for one unit. Each peer signs a thread of its attestations plus the bond behind them, and a honeypot audit each epoch forces one random signer to reveal its key lineage. Failing burns the bond. Faking diversity then costs an upfront price the forger cannot reclaim, so a modest lagoon of bonded verifiers outweighs a million unbacked accounts and the true signal survives.
